subject: Biology
purpose: Combine radial/exarch root anatomy with a ring of open stem bundles.
must_show: X: four xylem arms, outer protoxylem tips, phloem between arms. Y: ring of conjoint bundles around pith; inset with inward xylem, middle cambium and outward phloem.
alt: Radial root tissues with outer protoxylem are compared with ring-arranged open stem bundles.
prohibited: Root/stem identification, exarch/endarch words or the predicted secondary tissue answer.

subject: Biology
purpose: Read cut topology and equal-size fragment multiplicity.
must_show: Circular DNA 6 kb with two E sites delimiting 2 kb and 4 kb arcs; linear DNA 6 kb with E sites at 2 kb and 4 kb from the left end.
alt: Two restriction sites partition circular and linear DNA differently.
prohibited: Fragment counts, final gel bands or the answer.

subject: Chemistry
purpose: Resolve every heavy-atom bond order for bond and hybridisation counting.
must_show: CH2=CH-C(=O)-O-CH2-C triple N with a separately drawn carbonyl O and triple nitrile bond. All carbon hydrogens are explicit in atom-group labels.
alt: An alkene-carbonyl-ether-nitrile chain has explicit double and triple bonds.

subject: Chemistry
purpose: Compare local octets in two equal-total-electron Lewis proposals.
must_show: P: CO triple bond, one lone pair on each atom. Q: CO double bond, one lone pair on C and two on O; labels P,Q.
alt: Two CO Lewis proposals have different bond orders and lone-pair distributions.
prohibited: Formal charges, octet totals or a valid/invalid label.

subject: Chemistry
purpose: Read the two distinct carbonyl types and their para-connected skeleton.
must_show: Benzene ring with para CHO and C(=O)CH3 groups; explicit bonds from ring to each carbonyl carbon.
alt: A benzene ring bears an aldehyde and a para methyl-ketone group.
prohibited: Reduced product, test results or stereocentre count.

subject: Chemistry
purpose: Preserve a six-carbon chain between two aldehyde termini for reverse ozonolysis.
must_show: O=CH-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH=O as one connected molecular graph; each aldehyde carbon has H.
alt: One six-carbon open chain terminates in two aldehydes.
prohibited: Parent ring, ring name or a reconnecting answer bond.

subject: Physics
purpose: Read siphon elevations relative to the reservoir surface.
must_show: Open reservoir free surface z=0, constant-area siphon crest at z=H and outlet z=-5 m open to atmosphere. Atmospheric and vapour heads 10 m and 1 m.
alt: A siphon rises H above an open reservoir and exits five metres below its surface.
prohibited: Speed, calculated pressure or limiting crest height.

subject: Physics
purpose: Read cycle orientation and state coordinates for per-leg heat/work.
must_show: P versus V rectangle A(V0,P0), D(V0,2P0), C(2V0,2P0), B(2V0,P0), arrows A-D-C-B-A, ticks V0,2V0 and P0,2P0.
alt: A rectangular pressure-volume cycle expands on its upper-pressure leg.
prohibited: Heat, work, efficiency values or shaded area.

subject: Physics
purpose: Identify extrema of a potential graph before charge-sign energy conversion.
must_show: V/V0 versus x/a for [(x/a)^2-1]^2, zeros at -1,+1, central value 1, ticks -1,0,+1, and graph axes.
alt: A symmetric potential has minima at plus and minus a and a local maximum at zero.
prohibited: Stable/unstable labels, charge-force arrows or the answer.

subject: Physics
purpose: Read the two prism normals and internal-angle sum.
must_show: Triangular prism apex 60 degrees, n=sqrt3, air outside, left entry normal with i,r1, right exit normal with r2,e; generic unsolved path consistent with r1+r2=60.
alt: A ray crosses a sixty-degree prism with labelled angles at both surface normals.
prohibited: Threshold incidence, critical-angle value or minimum deviation.

subject: Biology
purpose: Distinguish upper epidermal enlarged cells from bundle sheath and mesophyll layers.
must_show: Leaf section with stomata on upper/lower epidermides, groups of large upper epidermal cells, undifferentiated mesophyll and a vascular bundle.
alt: An isobilateral leaf section contains enlarged upper epidermal cells and similar mesophyll throughout.
prohibited: Bulliform, monocot or C4 answer labels; a palisade layer.

subject: Biology
purpose: Track linkage of origin, marker and insert on distinct molecules.
must_show: Separate circular maps P with functional ori and no resistance gene; Q with insert and resistance gene and deleted ori; no connection between molecules.
alt: Separate plasmids distribute a replication origin and an insert-linked resistance marker between them.
prohibited: Stable/unstable labels, rescue arrows or the correct modification.

subject: Chemistry
purpose: Compare available axial/equatorial and octahedral domain sites without assigning the lone pairs.
must_show: S at centre of a five-site trigonal-bipyramidal schematic, two axial and three equatorial sites; Xe at centre of six-site octahedral schematic. Captions four F plus one lone pair, and four F plus two lone pairs.
alt: Five and six candidate electron-domain positions surround sulfur and xenon.
prohibited: Final lone-pair placement or molecular-shape answer labels.

subject: Chemistry
purpose: Read pairwise trans relationships in two octahedral occupancies.
must_show: Six sites labelled plus/minus x,y,z in each P,Q projection. P has A at +x,+y,+z; Q has A at +x,-x,+z; B elsewhere.
alt: Two octahedral coordinate occupancies differ in whether an A-A trans pair is present.

subject: Chemistry
purpose: Read acceptor and donor carbonyl connectivity before the specified crossed reaction.
must_show: Benzaldehyde as an actual aromatic ring attached to C(H)=O and ethanal as CH3-C(H)=O; names identify the reactants only.
alt: Benzaldehyde and ethanal have their aldehyde carbonyl carbons explicitly connected to different groups.
prohibited: Enolate arrow, addition product, dehydrated product or final alcohol.

subject: Physics
purpose: Integrate a time-varying acceleration rather than treating it as piecewise constant.
must_show: a in m/s2 versus t in seconds, straight segment from (0,0) to (4,-8), ticks 0,1,2,3,4 and 0,-2,-4,-6,-8; initial v=+4 m/s note.
alt: Acceleration decreases linearly from zero to minus eight metres per second squared in four seconds.
prohibited: Velocity, displacement, turning-time annotation or shaded area.

subject: Physics
purpose: Read how a marked small face belongs to an assembled symmetric cube.
must_show: Textbook wireframe large cube divided into eight side-a cubes, central q, one quarter of one outer face labelled F; centre/outer relationship clear.
alt: Eight small cubes surround a central charge, with one small outer face marked F.
prohibited: Flux values or computed fraction; rendered surface shading.

subject: Physics
purpose: Follow balanced-bridge nodes and series branch loading.
must_show: Ideal 12 V source across top/bottom; two left 100-ohm arms, right upper 100(1+0.004T), right lower 200(1-beta T), galvanometer across middle nodes; only right arms in bath.
alt: A bridge has fixed equal left resistors and temperature-dependent right resistors of opposite coefficient signs.
prohibited: Balanced resistance values, beta or power result.

subject: Physics
purpose: Resolve each diode polarity and the load branch at the clipped node.
must_show: Vin through 1 kohm to O, O through 1 kohm to ground; upper ideal diode anode O cathode +3 V reference, lower ideal diode anode -2 V reference cathode O. A,K labels and common-ground voltage convention.
alt: A loaded output node is linked by oppositely oriented ideal diodes to plus-three and minus-two volt reference nodes.
prohibited: On/off states, clipped output voltages or currents.
